fact: The police spokesman said the civil registry registration software (NADRA), hardware (Mühlbauer) and civil fingerprint system (Dermalog) were built by three foreign firms, and that the fingerprint system is state-licensed but run by the German firm, which the director general went to Germany to restart.
title: الناطق الرسمي باسم الشرطة العميد فتح الرحمن محمد التوم في حوار لأول النهار: استردينا نظام السجل المدني والبصمة المدنية
